About RecipeDB2

Cooking is the act of turning nature into a culture that has enabled the advent of the omnivorous human diet. The cultural wisdom of processing raw ingredients into delicious dishes is embodied in their cuisines. Recipes, thus, are the cultural capsules that encode elaborate cooking protocols for evoking sensory satiation as well as providing nourishment. As we stand on the verge of an epidemic of diet-linked disorders, it is important to investigate the culinary correlates of dietary elements to probe their association with sensory responses and consequences for nutrition and health.

RecipeDB2 is an extensive, structured compilation of recipes and their nutritional profiles. This repertoire comprises 128,942 recipes with 35,474 ingredients from 7 continents, 32 regions, 99 countries, and 34 states, further linked to nutritional profiles (USDA). This resource aims to facilitate scientific explorations of the culinary space (recipe, ingredients, cooking processes, dietary styles, etc.), seeking divergent applications.
